title: Corruption Pool
description: A pool of liquid corruption bubbles silently in a depression where the ground has given way to something deeper. Its surface is a mirror that reflects nothing — or perhaps reflects what lies beneath everything. The stone around its edges has crystallized into jagged formations, warped by prolonged exposure.

choices.label: Skim the corruption
choices.description: Carefully draw samples of the living corruption into sealed containers.

outcomes.text: Your container fills with sluggish black liquid that writhes against the glass. Potent corruption ichor — alchemists would kill for this.
The corruption reaches for your hands as you collect it. You pull back in time, but dark tendrils leave burning marks on your skin.
The pool surges upward! Corruption splashes across the party, eating through cloth and searing skin before you can scramble back.

choices.label: Harvest the crystallized edges
choices.description: Break off the entropy-saturated crystal formations ringing the pool.

outcomes.text: The crystals snap free cleanly, humming with trapped entropy. Their edges are razor-sharp and faintly warm.
Most of the crystals come free, but one shatters and releases a burst of stored entropy. The blast leaves a ringing in your ears.
The crystals crumble to worthless dust at your touch. This close to the pool, everything decays faster than expected.

choices.label: Leave it undisturbed
choices.description: The pool seems to watch you. Better not to linger.

outcomes.text: You back away slowly. The pool's surface ripples once — as if acknowledging your departure — then goes still.
